caption: The drawing depicts a dress with a fitted bodice and a wide, full skirt composed of two tiers. The primary color of the dress is lavender with a diamond-shaped pattern in white and subtle traces of yellow and pink. The dress has short sleeves, decorated with lace trim in white, and a wide white lace collar extending to the shoulders. The waistline is defined and pointed at the center. To the right of the main colored illustration, there is an inset line drawing showing the back view of the same dress, highlighting the neckline, lace collar, sleeves, and the tiered structure of the skirt. The background is a plain, cream-colored paper.
title: Dress
